Rally the corgi has sniffed out two more Christmas events for kids in Lincoln for 2026, bringing the page to 24 events. The new Holiday of Trees at Westminster Presbyterian Church (December 4 and 5) takes a freewill donation at the door, and Breakfast with Santa in the Haymarket (December 5) sells tickets at $15 for ages 4 and up, with children 3 and under free.

What Rally found in Lincoln

  • 24 Christmas events for kids in Lincoln, 2 new
  • New free event: Holiday of Trees (freewill donation)
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa in the Haymarket, December 5 (8 to 11 am)

Planning a bigger day out? Lincoln families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Omaha, which covers zoo lights, Santa visits and train rides across the metro.
